title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Stateful Privacy Sniffing of LLM Agents via Behavioral Covert Channels in Web Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2611.27046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on Web interaction, issuing searches, following links, and reading pages, to complete complex user tasks. Since each action is driven by the agent's private context, including the user's prompt, dialogue history, memory, and connected data, it also opens a new privacy exposure surface. Prior attacks either passively analyze network traffic, which yields only coarse correlations, or hijack the agent through indirect prompt injection, which must place sensitive content in an outgoing field and is blocked by content-level defenses. Whether an attacker can actively recover fine-grained private context without any explicit transmission thus remains insufficiently understood.   Our insight is that an agent's benign Web decisions themselves leak private context, as what it chooses to visit encodes whether, which, and in what order it acts, forming a behavioral covert channel. translated_title: 行胜于言：通过Web交互中的行为隐蔽信道对LLM智能体进行有状态隐私嗅探
translated_abstract: LLM智能体越来越多地依赖Web交互——发起搜索、点击链接、阅读网页——来完成复杂的用户任务。由于每个动作都由智能体的私有上下文驱动，包括用户的提示词、对话历史、记忆以及关联数据，这也开辟了一个新的隐私暴露面。先前的攻击要么被动分析网络流量，只能获得粗粒度的关联；要么通过间接提示注入劫持智能体，而这种方式必须将敏感内容放入输出字段中，因而会被内容级防御所阻断。因此，攻击者能否在不进行任何显式传输的情况下主动恢复细粒度的私有上下文，目前仍缺乏充分的研究。我们的核心洞察是：智能体良性的Web决策本身就会泄露私有上下文，因为它选择访问的内容编码了它是否行动、执行了什么行动以及行动的先后顺序，从而形成了一个行为隐蔽信道。基于这一洞察，我们设计了SNOOP，一个有状态的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 这篇论文提出SNOOP系统，利用LLM智能体在Web交互中的良性决策行为本身构成的行为隐蔽信道，无需任何显式数据传输即可主动嗅探并恢复智能体的细粒度私有上下文，揭示了一种现有攻击和防御手段均未覆盖的新型隐私攻击面。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SNOOP, a stateful privacy sniffing system that exploits behavioral covert channels embedded in LLM agents' benign web decisions to recover fine-grained private context without any explicit transmission, revealing a novel privacy attack surface not covered by prior passive traffic analysis or prompt-injection attacks.
